responsibility: This configure fragment registers the jit language/module with GCC’s configure framework. It declares the module name, marks that jit has no standalone compiler executable or target library additions, identifies the frontend source used for gengtype processing, and records that libgccjit support is not built by default because it depends on a host-shared GCC build. Its role is configuration-time discovery and enablement of gcc/jit, not code generation or API implementation.
